newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK average pay rise 7.0 pct so far in 1997- survey.
newsitem.headline: HK average pay rise 7.0 pct so far in 1997- survey.

text.p: The average pay rise in Hong Kong has been about 7.0 percent this year, according to a survey conducted by the Hong Kong Institute of Human Resource Management.
"This continues the progressive downward trend of pay adjustment that has occurred over the past seven years," the institute said in a statement.
"At all the levels of staff studied in the survey, over 85 percent of the surveyed companies gave less (in pay rise) this year than last," it added.
The pay rise of 7.0 percent is close to the growth in Hong Kong's consumer price index (A), the broadest measure of inflation, which rose 6.6 percent year-on-year in January, the statement said.
The survey polled 60 prominent companies, with a total of over 67,000 employees, which awarded pay rises in January this year.
